description: Towarowa Giełda Energii (TGE), the Polish Power Exchange, publishes market data on its website. Quotations cover electricity on the day-ahead market and the intraday continuous market (SIDC, formerly XBID) with archives, natural gas on the day-ahead and intraday markets, and the property rights market for certificates. Market coupling pages, in TGE's role as a nominated electricity market operator (NEMO), show flows, an archive of available transmission capacity and aggregated auction curves. TGE also keeps the registers of certificates of origin and guarantees of origin, publishes statistical data and quarterly market summaries (for example the second quarter of 2026), and runs further data platforms (Air.tge.pl and Gpi.tge.pl). Coverage is Poland and its coupled borders; resolution is hourly or product-level prices and volumes. Format and access: web tables and archives; the site's terms of use set the rules for using quotation data. Licence: TGE website terms of use (quotation data rules). Free to view. Caveats: tge.pl reset connections from the cloud shell, so the pages were read through a second network, and download formats were not checked. Simulation uses: prices, volumes and cross-border flows for power market, gas supply and capacity planning models of Poland. Related records: the hourly Polish electricity day-ahead market dataset builds on these prices.
